philosophy.title:
Beauty rooted
*in calm.*
philosophy.lede:
We believe beauty flourishes from feeling comfortable and empowered in your own skin.

That starts with calm. Inflammation is eased, the barrier is supported — and only then is skin receptive enough for results that actually last.

triad.title: *Holistic*
triad.body: Barrier repair, hydration, long-term wellness — not quick fixes. Every visit builds toward skin that holds up on its own, backed by education that outlasts the treatment.

triad.title: *Personal*
triad.body: No one-size-fits-all. Every facial is tailored to your skin type and concerns, guided by a clear, consistent method — so results are never a guess.

triad.title: *Restorative*

services.title: The menu.

items.name: Mei Glow Facial
items.description: A treatment focused on complexion refinement and radiance — designed for clients seeking brighter, more even, naturally polished skin. Medical-grade Korean formulations meet gentle device work and sculpting massage, including a double cleanse, custom light peel, micro-current hydration infusion, lymphatic sculpting massage, and layered masking, finished with essences and serums chosen for your skin's needs. The result: hydrated, radiant, bouncy skin with smoother texture and a refined glow.

items.name: Mei Reset Facial
items.description: A boutique treatment for stressed, irritated, or reactive skin, drawing on the clinical approach of Japanese and Korean skin studios — medical-grade Korean formulations paired with advanced skin technologies. Each session is customized to calm redness, rebuild the skin barrier, and restore comfort and balance, using treatments like RF lifting, plasma + high-frequency, and multi-modal circulation support alongside Dr. esthé, Dermabell, and Éclat du teint. The result: calmer, clearer skin with a replenished, resilient complexion.

items.name: Mei Cica Facial
items.description: Built around Centella Asiatica — a clinical-grade ingredient prized for its ability to heal, soothe, and calm irritation. This classic facial is elevated with three exclusive strategies: Éclat du Teint's Vital Peeling Solution, a CICA and PHA exfoliating mask that gently clears buildup while preserving moisture balance; a custom ampoule and serum cocktail delivered with High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound for deeper absorption, non-invasive lifting, and collagen stimulation; and Éclat du Teint's CICA B5 modeling mask, layered over a cream mask to lock in hydration and visibly reduce redness. No downtime. CICA-driven formulations. Restorative care

services.footnote: All services are bespoke. We professionally assess, listen to your input and preferences, and make recommendations accordingly.

aboutMei.title: Meet Brianna
aboutMei.lede: Brianna is an esthetician and the founder of Mei Skin. Her education shapes how she reads skin concerns, listens to client needs, and creates a nurturing environment in the treatment room. She brings over five years of experience at Vancouver's top luxury spas, alongside in-house education with BABOR, Éminence Organic Skin Care, Knesko Skin, Dr.esthé, Éclat du teint, Dermabell, and more. Her curiosity about ingredients and formulation is insatiable — she's always studying what works, and what's next.
aboutMei.body: Outside the treatment room, Brianna practices yoga, and has interests in health and wellness, informing the calm, considered energy of mei skin.
aboutMei.pull_quote: Good skincare should be bespoke — your skin changes, and your skin is unique to you.

items.q: What should I expect on my first visit?
items.a: Your first visit begins with a cleanse, followed by a skin reading — a conversation to understand your skin's history, habits, and what it needs right now. From there, we build a treatment around you.

Every facial at Mei Skin is bespoke. We draw from a variety of techniques and technologies, including custom facial peel cocktails, microcurrent hydration infusion, lymphatic sculpting massage, RF eye/face lifting, layered masking, ultrasonic skin scrubber extractions, high-frequency with plasma, paired with professional-grade Korean formulations chosen for your skin that day. A 60-minute visit (The Mei Glow) covers the essentials; a 90-minute visit (The Mei Reset) gives us more time to go deeper.

items.q: How long are appointments, and how often should I come?
items.a: Sessions currently run either 60 to 90 minutes, depending on how much time you want to give your skin that day. We recommend every a treatment every 4-6 weeks to achieve and maintain results.

items.q: Do I need to do anything to prepare for my visit?
items.a: We recommend arriving without makeup if you can — every visit starts with a double cleanse, so it will come off either way, but skipping it beforehand means we can start reading your skin right away. And if you're wearing sunscreen when you walk in, even better — we love that. In the week leading up to your visit, please avoid retinol and exfoliating products, and please book at least month after a chemical peel, microneedling, or facial laser treatment.

items.q: What should I do after my visit?
items.a: You're welcome to cleanse as usual at the end of the day. The one habit we'll always encourage: wear sunscreen every day, rain or shine. Even on cloudy days, UV rays still reach your skin, so keeping that protection consistent is one of the best things you can do for your results.

Absolutely. We have retail products from Dermabell, Éclat du Teint, Dr. esthé, and more available to purchase on-site. We would be delighted to recommend products for your home care routine should you be interested.
There's paid underground parking directly below the studio at 2080 West Broadway. Free street parking is also available along Maple St, Cypress St, and W 10th, 11th, and 12th.
We ask for at least 48 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations within 48 hours are subject to a 50% fee, and cancellations within 24 hours are subject to a 100% fee.

privacy.title: privacy *policy.*
privacy.intro:
mei skin studio runs this website. this page explains what happens to your information when you visit it.

the short version: this site collects very little, we don't sell anything to anyone, and there are no advertising trackers here.

sections.heading: information collection and use
sections.body:
**what you give us.** the appointment request form on this site asks for your name, email, and optionally your phone number, which treatment you're interested in, and when suits you. when you send it, that goes straight to our studio inbox as an email. it isn't stored in a database, and it isn't passed to any advertising or marketing company.

please don't send skin conditions, medications, or other health details through the form — we go through all of that with you in person at your first visit, where it belongs.

when you email or message us, we keep that correspondence so we can reply, book you in, and remember your skin history between visits.

**what's collected automatically.** basic technical information about your visit:

- which pages you looked at, and for how long
- the site or search that sent you here
- your rough region — city or country level, never a precise address
- browser and device type

we look at this in aggregate to understand which parts of the site are useful. it isn't used to build a profile of you.

sections.heading: cookies and local storage
sections.body:
this site sets no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

the one thing stored in your browser is a small flag remembering that you entered the preview password, so you aren't asked for it on every page. it lives on your device, is never sent to us, and clearing your browsing data removes it.

sections.heading: third-party services
sections.body:
two services are involved in serving this site:

- **vercel** — hosts the website and provides its visitor analytics. the analytics are cookie-free and don't follow you to other sites.
- **google fonts** — serves the typefaces used here. as part of loading them, your ip address is visible to google.

we don't run advertising pixels, and nothing about your visit is shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: your choices and rights
sections.body:
under british columbia's personal information protection act and canada's PIPEDA, you can ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.

email us and we'll respond within 30 days. there's no charge for a reasonable request.

sections.heading: security
sections.body:
we take reasonable measures to protect the information we hold, and we keep as little of it as possible — the less that exists, the less there is to lose.

that said, no method of transmitting information over the internet is completely secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: changes to this privacy policy
sections.body: if this policy changes, the updated version will appear on this page with a new date at the top. material changes will be flagged on the site.

terms.title: Terms & *conditions.*
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern the use of this website and the services provided by Mei Skin ("Mei Skin," "we," "us," or "our"), operated by Brianna Wong, sole proprietor, doing business as "Mei Skin," based in Vancouver, British Columbia. By booking an appointment or using this website, you ("you" or "the client") agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.heading: 1. Booking and Appointments
sections.body:
Appointments are requested by email or Instagram and confirmed directly by Mei Skin. A requested time is not held or guaranteed until confirmation has been provided.

1.1 Cancellations and Rescheduling. Clients are asked to provide at least 48 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations or rescheduling requests made within 48 hours of the appointment will be charged 50% of the price of the booked service. Cancellations or rescheduling requests made within 24 hours of the appointment will be charged 100% of the price of the booked service. As each appointment reserves a single treatment room, a late cancellation results in an unfilled appointment slot.

1.2 Late Arrival. We will make reasonable efforts to accommodate late arrivals; however, a late start may result in a shortened treatment in order to avoid delaying subsequent appointments.

1.3 No-Shows. A missed appointment without prior notice will be charged in full.

sections.heading: treatments and results
sections.body:
the services offered here are esthetic skin treatments. they are not medical care, and nothing said in the studio or on this site is a diagnosis or medical advice. if something on your skin concerns you, please see a physician or dermatologist.

before your first visit, tell us about:

- skin conditions, allergies, or recent reactions
- medications and actives you're using — retinoids, acids, accutane in particular
- recent treatments, injectables, or procedures
- pregnancy or breastfeeding

some treatments aren't appropriate in these situations, and a few are unsafe. we may patch test, modify, or decline a treatment when it's the safer call — that judgment is part of the service, not an inconvenience.

skin is individual. results vary between people and between visits, and no particular outcome is guaranteed.

sections.heading: pricing and payment
sections.body:
the prices on the menu are the prices you pay. there are no add-ons applied at the desk.

payment is due at the time of your appointment. prices may change over time; the price quoted when you book is the price honoured for that visit.

sections.heading: gift cards
sections.body:
gift cards are available in any amount, delivered electronically or as a printed card. they don't expire.

they aren't refundable and can't be exchanged for cash.

sections.heading: website content
sections.body:
the writing, photographs, and design on this site belong to mei skin studio. please don't republish or reuse them without asking first.

we try to keep everything here accurate and current, but the site is provided as-is.

sections.body: how your information is handled is set out separately in our privacy policy.

sections.heading: changes to these terms
sections.body: these terms may be updated from time to time. the current version always lives on this page, with its date at the top.
